entries.alt: Four fictional adult women sit in an affectionate diagonal cluster above Marina Bay and the Helix Bridge. A blonde rests against a Black woman's clothed lap while two dark-haired women lean in. Short red and white looks, rainbow platforms, rainbow ankle boots and silver knee-high boots frame the high-oblique view.

Four fictional adult women share a seated handclasp and side hug at Gardens by the Bay's Supertree Grove. They wear short red, white and metallic Singapore-inspired outfits with red stilettos, white boots, silver knee-high boots and rainbow knee-high hosiery.

Four fictional adult women gather in a close affectionate composition before Jewel Changi's Rain Vortex. A Black woman and blonde stand beside a seated dark-haired woman while a brunette leans in. Singapore flag panels, rainbow hosiery and scorpion, star and GRD tattoos remain visible.

Four fictional adult women share a supported seated conversation and joined hands within Henderson Waves' timber ribs. Short burgundy, white and red looks, varied heels and boots, RAZE marks, stars and love tattoos accompany the affectionate group.
